sections.heading: Podio buyer question and thesis
sections.body:
contact management is the hinge on this Podio setup page — not a generic crm lecture.

Buyer question: is Podio the right crm commit for Teams wanting highly customizable CRM-like apps, or is Teams wanting out-of-the-box sales CRM best practices the real constraint?

Thesis for setup: Podio is a yes only when contact management plus contact management are must-haves; not worth it if Teams wanting out-of-the-box sales CRM best practices dominates the operating model.

Best for: Teams wanting highly customizable CRM-like apps; Small teams starting on Free (5 users); Buyers who prefer flexible work platform over rigid CRM (Teams wanting highly customizable CRM-like apps).

Poor fit when: Teams wanting out-of-the-box sales CRM best practices; Buyers needing polished email sequencing CRM; Enterprises needing dedicated SFA governance. Avoid if Work platform — CRM is DIY/custom vs dedicated sales CRM would block go-live.

sections.heading: Podio limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Work platform — CRM is DIY/custom vs dedicated sales CRM; Free capped at 5 users; Sales reporting/email CRM depth depends on how you build apps because it forces process changes or add-ons around Podio when contact management is the job.

Pricing interpretation: stay on Free until contact management is mandatory; plan jumps to Plus only after that hinge is proven.

Plan trade-off: you gain contact management at the expense of Published packaging clarity vs ecosystem depth — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Free · free · contact management | Plus | Premium.

Alternative context: unlike monday sales CRM, Podio is preferable when Teams wanting highly customizable CRM-like apps because contact management plus contact management match; prefer monday sales CRM when Teams wanting out-of-the-box sales CRM best practices because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Podio
sections.body:
Use-case: for Teams wanting highly customizable CRM-like apps running contact management, prefer Podio when contact management is weekly; pick another path when Teams wanting out-of-the-box sales CRM best practices.

Setup requires a specialist owner when Work platform — CRM is DIY/custom vs dedicated sales CRM collides with contact management; SMB pilots can stay lighter if contact management is already on Plus.

Wrap: choose Podio only if the setup job is contact management under Teams wanting highly customizable CRM-like apps; otherwise use Finder constraints instead of copying this page for another vendor.
